senses.definition: Impf. 3 fs. of beasts תְּדוּר Dn 4:18; 3 mpl. birds יְדֻרוּן v 9 (Qr f. יִדוּרָן, f. subj., צִפֲּרֵי, follows, cf.v 18 and K§ 98, 2 c, Anm. 3); Pt. pl. of men, דָּארִין Kt 2:38; 3:31; 6:26 (Qr דָּֽיְרִין); as subst., cstr. דָּארֵי Kt 4:32(×2) (Qr דָּֽיְרֵי) dwellers.
